column1: # The index examples/typst-caption-lists.qmd prints in a Typst render (M115).
# Derived BY HAND from that source, under the ORACLE RULE at the head of
# tests/run-tests.sh, and never copied from a render. The row shape is the one
# tests/typst-index-main.tsv states.
# The pages come from the source's explicit page breaks: page 1 holds only
# the title and the three lists, each break starts the next page, and the same three lists
# follow on page 10. Each term is one case. A caption mark's locator is its
# caption's page, never page 1 or page 10, where a list copies the caption:
#   alder    the caption of a picture with no id, page 2, on a mark carrying
#            the id `alder-mark`, which a raw Typst link on page 9 names
#   birch    a principal mark in the caption of a picture with an id, page 3:
#            one bold locator
#   cedar    the caption of a picture div, page 4
#   dogwood  a range opened in the caption of a table with an id on page 5,
#            closed in the text on page 6: one range, linked to page 5
#   elder    the caption of a table div, page 7
#   hazel    the caption of a code listing, page 8
#   larch    a mark in the text, page 9, which no list copies
